dimension_description: This salinity scale stores dissolved-salt content as mass fraction. That makes freshwater, blood plasma, seawater, brines, and hypersaline lakes comparable on one axis. The exact chemical makeup varies, so these are representative total-salinity benchmarks rather than precise ionic analyses.
